title: upgrade offers --force for released files, which --force can never reach
body:
Found by the 2026-09-21 doc audit (finding K6).

`upgrade` closed with "N file(s) left alone because they differ from what was installed. Re-run with --force to replace them", counting RELEASED files (no longer shipped, edited, left with the project) in N. --force never reaches a released file: the manifest no longer lists it, so the next upgrade has no entry for it. fleet's held-files remedy already says so.

Fix: released files are counted apart and get their own remedy (delete it, or move it out of bin/.devbin/lib/); the --force advice counts only files edited in place. The summary line `N added, N updated, N unchanged, N removed, N skipped` is UNCHANGED on purpose -- fleet's `upgrade_held` parses it across devbin versions -- and `skipped` still includes released files. Tests: install.bats, the edited-orphan arm and a new mixed arm, driven red at the parent commit.


## Resolution

Fixed at `9c13f29`, test driven red first at its parent commit. Full suite 1578/1579 at `ae3b200`: the one failing arm was environment-caused (GIT_OPTIONAL_LOCKS=0 exported in the running shell defeated readonlygit.bats' stale fixture, and its control arm caught it) and is green in a clean environment; that file is hardened at `ad86870`. Reviewed by vc against this issue; vc's mutants on 0099 and 0104 were killed. Ships in 0.1.4.
